senses.gloss: m. (= b. h. זֵרוּעַ; זרע) sowing; seed.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:37">Targ. O. Lev. XI, 37</cite>.—Pl. <he>זֵרוּעִין</he>, <cite ref="G00391"><he>זֵי׳</he></cite>.
Targ. Is. LXI, 11 זֵרוּעָהָא (ed. Lag. זֵירוּעָהּ sing.). [Y. Sabb. IX, 12ᵃ top; Y. Kil. III, beg. 28ᶜ (ref. to Is. l. c.) זֵירוּעֶיהָ מליא zerûëha is spelt plene (with ו); v. יאנא.]
